topics.title: China Early Asset Team 2025 Goal Setting – Mental Health (NR2B NAM, GOATi, mGluR4 NAM, SSTR4 ago.)

background.text: China Early Asset Team in TA Mental Health has set 2025 goals across co-creation, integration, and execution excellence for NR2B NAM, GOATi, mGluR4 NAM, and SSTR4 ago.
background.quote: Goal Setting – China Early Asset Team in TA Mental Health & Eye Health

background.text: Co-creation targets include NR2B NAM light IAP co-creation, AEP evidence gap for NR2B NAM/GOATi/mGluR4 NAM, supporting NR2B NAM Global AB meeting, and providing price assumptions for NR2B NAM in 25LTF (2030 launch).
background.quote:
NR2B NAM light IAP co-creation
AEP evidence gap for China: NR2B NAM, GOATi, mGluR4 NAM, etc.
Support NR2B NAM Global AB meeting
Provide price assumptions for NR2B NAM in 25LTF (2030 launch)

background.text: China integration plan timelines: NR2B NAM Ph3 trials in MDD integration Q2 2025; China integration/launch strategy in CT-155/156 Q3 2025 (based on global Ph3 readout); SSTR4 ago. Ph2 PoCP trial integration Q2–Q3 2025; GOAT inh. Ph2 PoCC trial integration Q4 2025.
background.quote:
NR2B NAM Ph3 trials in MDD integration: Q2 2025
China integration/launch strategy in CT-155/156: Q3 2025 (based on global Ph3 readout)
SSTR4 ago. Ph2 PoCP trial integration: Q2-Q3 2025
GOAT inh. Ph2 PoCC trial integration: Q4 2025

background.text: Execution milestones for NR2B NAM: Pre-IND for Ph2 trial in BD in Q3 2025; EoPII meeting for MDD Ph2 trials in Q3 2025; CTA for Ph3 trials in MDD in Q4 2025.
background.quote:
NR2B NAM:
Pre-IND for Ph2 trial in BD in Q3 2025
EoPII meeting for MDD Ph2 trials in Q3 2025
CTA for Ph3 trials in MDD in Q4 2025

background.text: Early stakeholder engagement goals for NR2B NAM in MDD: KEE mapping and engagement, NAB meeting in Q3 2025 to collect KEE insights, Ph2 data dissemination, CDE engagement on precision psychiatry approach in Q2 2025, and release of MDD Clinical Trial Willingness & Placebo Drivers at DIA CNS innovative forum in Aug 2025.
background.quote:
NR2B NAM:
MDD KEE mapping and KEE engagement
NAB meeting in Q3 to collect KEE insights
Ph2 Data dissemination and communication
Precision psychiatry clinical development: Engage with CDE and seek strategical advice on “precision psychiatry approach to clinical development” in Q2.
Complete and release < MDD Clinical Trial Willingness & Placebo Drivers > at DIA CNS innovative forum in Aug.2025

background.text: Smooth handover goal: ensure seamless transfer of NR2B NAM to local asset team once local full execution mode is requested by RMM after Ph2 readout.
background.quote: Ensure smooth handover of NR2B NAM to local asset team once local full execution mode is requested by RMM after Ph2 readout.
